content.short: Coinbase Wallet is an EVM compatible software wallet.
content.description: Coinbase Wallet is an EVM-compatible software wallet launched in 2018 by the creators of Coinbase. It enables users to purchase ERC-20 tokens and NFTs and to participate in airdrops, all from a single wallet interface. For developers, the wallet can connect directly to testnet faucets via a wallet extension and can be integrated with decentralized applications and protocols for lending and payments, supporting seamless interaction with on-chain services.
